nodes.name: Google Sheets Queue Trigger
nodes.notes: Input: one newly appended Automation Queue row. Output: named queue columns. Errors: trigger credential or sheet access failure.

nodes.name: Normalize Student Queue Row
nodes.notes: Validates the queue state and operation, parses the Google Form JSON, generates a correlation ID and builds the stable RPC request. Raw identity data is not logged.

nodes.name: Is Queue Row Processable?
nodes.notes: True: pending row for this workflow. False: stale, duplicate or mismatched queue row.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { 'p_request': { 'operation':'workflow.run.log', 'correlation_id': $('Normalize Student Queue Row').item.json.request.correlation_id, 'idempotency_key': $('Normalize Student Queue Row').item.json.request.idempotency_key + ':workflow-start', 'source':{'channel':'n8n'}, 'payload':{ 'workflow_code':'01-student-intake', 'n8n_execution_id':$execution.id, 'operation':'student.profile.submit', 'run_status':'started', 'input_summary':{'form_response_id':$('Normalize Student Queue Row').item.json.queue.formResponseId} } } } }}

nodes.name: Log Workflow Start
nodes.notes: Best-effort durable workflow start evidence. Failure does not block the primary business operation.

nodes.name: Submit Business RPC
nodes.notes: Calls the stable public Supabase RPC through the server-side service-role credential. Transport failures are retried three times; business failures are not retried.

nodes.name: Build Student Queue Outcome
nodes.notes: Converts the HTTP/RPC response into a sanitized Automation Queue outcome. It never writes stack traces or provider credentials.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { 'p_request': { 'operation':'workflow.run.log', 'correlation_id': $('Normalize Student Queue Row').item.json.request.correlation_id, 'idempotency_key': $('Normalize Student Queue Row').item.json.request.idempotency_key + ':workflow-completion', 'source':{'channel':'n8n'}, 'payload':{ 'workflow_code':'01-student-intake', 'n8n_execution_id':$execution.id, 'operation':'student.profile.submit', 'run_status': $('Build Student Queue Outcome').item.json.success ? 'completed' : 'failed', 'output_summary':{'queue_status':$('Build Student Queue Outcome').item.json['Processing Status']}, 'error_code':$('Build Student Queue Outcome').item.json['Error Code'], 'error_message':$('Build Student Queue Outcome').item.json['Error Message'] } } } }}

nodes.name: Log Workflow Completion
nodes.notes: Best-effort completed/failed workflow evidence. Notification or logging failure cannot undo the already durable business RPC result.

nodes.name: Update Automation Queue
nodes.notes: Updates exactly one queue row by immutable Form Response ID. Stores only sanitized status, correlation and error fields.

nodes.name: Skip Non-Pending Queue Row
nodes.notes: Expected terminal path for rows already completed/failed/processing or for another operation. No business action is performed.
